title: KnowledgeBase Pro
problem_statement: Companies struggle to manage internal knowledge effectively. Employees waste time searching for information that should be easily accessible. KnowledgeBase Pro will solve this by providing a better way to organize and share company knowledge across teams.
target_users: All employees who need to find company information
Team leads who want to document processes
New hires who need to get up to speed quickly
user_stories: As an employee, I want to search for company documentation so that I can find answers to my questions
As a team lead, I want to create and organize documents so that my team has access to important information
As a new hire, I want to easily find onboarding materials so that I can learn about the company
As an admin, I want to manage user permissions so that sensitive information is protected
acceptance_criteria: Users should be able to create, edit, and delete documents
Search functionality should return relevant results
The system should support different permission levels
Documents should be easy to format and organize

success_metrics.target: Many documents created by employees over time

risks_open_questions: Getting employees to actually use a new tool can be difficult
Content may become outdated if not maintained
Integration with existing tools needs to be considered
out_of_scope: Features not planned for this version
To be determined based on user feedback
